intro: The Great Cat Spirit is a sacred druidic quest summoning practitioners to Nighthaven in Moonglade to meet Dendrite Starblaze. Having already mastered the aspect of the bear, druids are called upon to begin their journey into the feline perspective of the wild under the blessings of Father Cenarius.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young adventurer. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.

clips.title: Completion
paras: And so it continues, Father Cenarius.
Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.

Greetings again, friend. It is time for you to learn the next perspective of nature: the cat. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but much like the bear, it is you that must embrace this learning and propagate it.
